risks.risk: Brand/model is unknown; different brands and tread quality change value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the sidewall where the brand name is readable.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used tyres (no brand premium).

risks.proof: A close-up photo of tread depth area plus a measurement (tread depth gauge reading) or a photo showing wear bars clearly.

risks.risk: Age (DOT week/year) is not readable; old tyres can be unsafe even if tread looks okay.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the DOT code on the sidewall (week/year).

risks.risk: Damage/repairs (cuts, punctures, sidewall bulges) are not confirmed.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as tyres with unverified integrity (worst case: assume may need replacement).

proof_requests: Send a clear sidewall close-up showing the full tyre size (e.g., 195/65R15) for the exact tyres being sold.
Send a clear sidewall close-up showing brand/model name.
Send a clear DOT code photo (week/year).

Send close-ups of sidewalls and tread for any cuts, punctures, patches, or bulges.
